rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a clear deteriorating sequence — price has stepped down from 16.02 to 15.75 with increasing volume on the down moves, suggesting near-term selling pressure. However, the spread is 50+ bps on a name that has already traveled from a low of $12.52 to a high of $16.15 today (an enormous intraday range relative to ATR), meaning the risk/reward on either side is poorly defined and slippage risk is high. With price at 90.4% of today's range and momentum rolling over, neither a long (chasing a near-exhausted move) nor a short (fighting a strong uptrend with wide spread and uncertain support) offers a mechanically sound setup at this moment.
